verdict.rationale: The portal documents acting on someone else's behalf in only two thin ways: subscribing to electronic notifications and citations 'em representação' (on another's behalf), and a dedicated services area for certified accountants (Contabilistas Certificados), which implies a recognised third-party role. Nothing in the pack publishes the actual scope of what a representative may or may not do. Missing for 10: published authorization/procuração forms, a defined catalogue of representative roles and their permissions, explicit rules on which acts or signatures remain personal, and any independent corroboration.
